records.subject: You're in -- let's get Timber Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for setting up Timber Partners on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Reached first project day 1 (fast start) but 6 days in with no invite sent and key_milestone unreached; only customer-initiated contact is a feature question (tick_00554fef017d) whose answer is 'not available yet', which may dampen momentum. Starter, solo, no reply to invite nudge [email:49740d49]; ticket still open [email:6292d382]. 8 days left.

draft.subject: Your weekly summary question — and a quick next step
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for writing in about the weekly summary email. To answer directly: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap. Tariq has your ticket open and will follow up there as well.

In the meantime, you've got your first project going in Wrenfield, and projects are the main organizing unit with tasks living inside them — the next step that usually matters most is getting your team lead and the rest of the team in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
